anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy select?

A) clear - remove all active filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve - keep all active filters across switches
C) restore - bring back each workspace's last filters on switch

Recommendation: B - it matches what the workspace-change handler does today, so the policy changes nothing for current users. It also needs no new per-workspace filter state beside the resolver at `settings/resolver.ts:12`.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
What should happen to report filters when you switch workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves current behavior and avoids introducing per-workspace filter storage.
